reviewMethod: Every actual screenshot opened with view_image; all hashes rechecked.

reviewed.label: stairs-lower
reviewed.observation: The squad begins at the lower approach; four shallow stairs and floor contact shadows are visible.

reviewed.label: stairs-middle
reviewed.observation: The leader has climbed partway, with followers on lower steps. Feet and shadows remain at their local supports.

reviewed.label: stairs-upper
reviewed.observation: The leader reaches the raised council landing; followers occupy the upper approach.

reviewed.label: stairs-returned
reviewed.observation: The leader has descended to an intermediate step, rather than reaching the lower approach. Actual export z=-17.368 confirms incomplete travel.

reviewed.label: failure
reviewed.observation: The same intermediate descending position remains visible behind the public banter overlay. No runtime error or geometry defect is evident.

failure: A fixed 900ms key hold returned only to z=-17.368, so the collector correctly rejected a lower-approach claim. The next collector uses additional actual keyboard holds only when real exports show incomplete traversal.
scope: Actual ascent is visible. Descent to the lower approach and later criteria were not completed in this attempt.
limitations: Native coordinate tests remain separate from viewport review.
No clock/cadence adjustment or product change is warranted by this collector failure.
